title: Defense Stocks Strain as Conflict Widens
text:
Becca Wasser and Chris Kennedy, adjunct senior fellows at the Center for a New American Security, join Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the Iran War and the its impact on U.S. defense stockpiles and global energy markets.
Watch the full interview on Bloomberg.
